## Project 4 — Track 3 Enhanced

**What changed (Track 3 — Data Inputs):**
✅ Hardcoded metrics (28%, $127, 47%) removed
✅ P02 micro-segments parsed into structured objects
   → Textured Neutral Minimalist (premium)
   → Retro Abstract Geometric (mid-range)
   → Luxury 3D Wool Abstract (premium)
✅ New Parse P03 Gaps node extracts:
   → Real pricing (Wayfair/Amazon/Walmart avgs)
   → Whitespace gaps with priority ratings
   → Feature gaps (washable, pet-friendly)
✅ AI prompt references actual segment+gap data
✅ Input validation added
✅ Build HTML renders 2 new sections:
   → Micro-Segment Content Strategy
   → Competitive Pricing & Whitespace

**Tracks 1 & 2 (Voice + Content Types)**
Coming in next iteration.
